title: A Star Out of Jacob
old_p1: Long ago, a man named Balaam saw far into the future. He said, “There shall come a Star out of Jacob.”
Jacob’s family was Israel. Stars help travelers find the way. Prophets, who speak for Heavenly Father, teach that this Star is Jesus!
When Jesus was born, wise men in the east saw His star. They came a long way to find the new King.
old_p2: The star went before them and stopped over the house where young Jesus was. They were full of joy! They knelt and worshiped Him, which means they loved and honored Him. They gave Him gold and sweet-smelling frankincense and myrrh.
Tonight, picture that bright star. You can find Jesus too, by learning about Him and following Him.
p1: Long before Jesus came to earth, a man named Balaam spoke of a star that would rise from Jacob's family. His words pointed toward a coming King.
Then, when Jesus was born, wise men far to the east saw a special star. They knew a King had come. So they set out on a long journey, watching the sky and looking for Him.
p2: At last, the star led them to the place where young Jesus was. Their hearts filled with joy. They bowed before Him and offered precious gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

The wise men had traveled a long way because finding Jesus mattered more than anything they carried. You can seek Him too. Each time you pray, read His words, or choose kindness, you take another step toward Him. Tonight, imagine that shining star lighting your way.
note: Levi, 20 Nov 2026 ("Match up the story lantern stories with the published book"): p1 and p2 are the story words AS PRINTED in the published December book (We Have Waited for Him, on Amazon), first and second story page, word for word, so the Lantern, the app's Books page and the book a family bought read the same. The Christian edition reads God for Heavenly Father; p2_christian only where the printed words are Latter-day Saint teaching. The 29 Oct picture-book rewrite is kept as rewrite_p1/rewrite_p2.
rewrite_p1: Long ago, Heavenly Father helped a man named Balaam see far ahead. Balaam said, “There shall come a Star out of Jacob.”
Jacob’s family was Israel, Heavenly Father’s people. A star shows travelers the way. Balaam was talking about Jesus!
When Jesus was born, wise men in the east saw His star. They came a long way to find the new King.
rewrite_p2: The star went ahead and stopped over the house where young Jesus was. The wise men were so full of joy! They knelt and worshiped Him. They gave Him gold and sweet-smelling frankincense and myrrh.
They kept following, and they found Jesus. Tonight, picture that bright star. You can keep looking for Jesus too, by learning about Him.
